name: Survival Legacy
niche: Firearms history and classic outdoor gear: where proven designs came from and whether they still hold up
audience: US adults 35-65 who own or collect firearms and outdoor gear, trust proven designs over trends and buy to keep for decades
tone: Calm expert. Plain facts, dry humour, no hype and no fear-selling
pillars: The story behind a famous design
Classic vs modern: does the old one still hold up?
Gear that lasted decades, and why
ctaStyle: One low-key line at the very end: ask which one they would keep for twenty years
rules: Reviews, history and published specs only
No instructions for modifying, converting or building firearms
Never show or describe shooting at people or animals
